## Page or section

Link to the affected document.

## What needs to change

Describe the incorrect or unclear information and the expected behavior.

## Version and context

If relevant, include your CLI version, operating system, and coding tool.

## Suggested correction

Include a proposed explanation or a minimal example. Use synthetic data and remove credentials or private transcripts.
